title: CRM Executive (Customer Support)
description:
The CRM Executive is the customer's single point of contact from the day of purchase to move-in and post-possession support. You manage the full 16-step lifecycle: onboarding, documentation, payments, construction updates, queries, modifications, inspections, snag closure, key handover and the transfer to Facility Management. The goal is a smooth, transparent and timely experience for every homebuyer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take over homebuyers from the Sales Team, collect their details and explain the CRM process.
* Coordinate documentation, agreement preparation, registration and home loan paperwork with banks.
* Track payment schedules, send demand reminders and work with Finance to issue receipts on time.
* Share verified construction progress and milestone updates with customers.
* Log, categorise and assign customer queries and complaints, and follow up until resolved.
* Record civil modification requests and coordinate cost estimates, approvals, execution and quality checks.
* Verify unit readiness with the project team and conduct pre-delivery inspections with customers.
* Manage the snag list from logging to rectification, re-inspection and written customer sign-off.
* Handle possession formalities and key handover, including the possession packet and signed acknowledgement.
* Coordinate move-in with the facility team, transfer open issues to the helpdesk, and close the CRM record as “Lifecycle Completed”.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline (BBA, B.Com or Civil/Construction background preferred).
* 1 - 3 years in CRM, customer support or post-sales, ideally in real estate or construction. Strong freshers will also be considered.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication in English, Kannada and/or Hindi.
* Strong follow-up discipline and ownership: no query is left open.
* Working knowledge of real estate documentation, payment schedules, home loans and RERA basics.
* Ability to read basic construction checklists and understand snag types (civil, electrical, plumbing, finishing).
* Proficiency with CRM software, Excel and Google Workspace or MS Office.
* Strong coordination across Sales, Finance, Legal, Projects, Quality and Facility teams.
* Patience, empathy and the ability to handle upset customers professionally.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

description:

------------------

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Information Technology & Digital**
------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

**About the role**
------------------

Explore the forefront of purposeful technology and innovation as an IT & D Business Analyst at Reckitt. Within our collaborative IT & Digital team, every day is a chance to create meaningful impact. Here, you'll be ensuring excellence across a global network that's dedicated to a cleaner, healthier world. If you possess a blend of strategic thinking and technical expertise, and you're ready to transform business needs into cutting-edge IT & D solutions, we would love to hear from you. Be the catalyst for change in a company committed to making a difference.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Analyse business needs, translating them into precise IT & D solutions, ensuring alignment with our strategic vision.
* Engage in data analysis, user research, and other studies to bolster product development and enhancements.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders such as product managers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver exemplary products.
* Navigate complex data landscapes, interpreting and defining specifications for technological processes.
* Act as a steward of change, facilitating communication between technical teams and business users for clarity and successful solution implementation.

**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------

* Proficient in analysing requirements and translating business processes into clear specifications.
* Familiar with manufacturing processes and a deep understanding of IT systems, cybersecurity, and data analytics.
* Well-versed in project and programme management, design thinking, and IT service management.
* Skilled in change management practises with a focus on stakeholder relationship management and user adoption.
* Strong communication skills, capable of advising and guiding diverse teams and stakeholders.

**The skills for success**
--------------------------

Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

**Equality**

Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. title: AVP National Sales & Business Development
description:
\*Please note this role is not for 2070 Health\*

**About Sukoon Health**

Sukoon provides inpatient mental healthcare for severe and complex mental health conditions and addiction. We are looking for a commercial leader who can help patients access high-quality care by strengthening referral relationships, developing effective sales teams and turning market opportunities into measurable business growth.

You will lead national sales and business development across our markets. Your work will combine time in the field with city managers and representatives, rigorous account planning, revenue-generating events and sales collateral that helps people understand Sukoon’s value. You will work closely with clinical, marketing, admissions, customer care and operations teams.

**Role Overview**

This is a role for someone who takes ownership of results and improves how other people sell. You should be comfortable accompanying representatives, demonstrating a consultative sales conversation, coaching managers and making clear decisions about account priorities and investment. You will join an existing operation with targets, processes and training in place, and strengthen execution while addressing specific gaps.

Success means more productive referral accounts, better sales-team performance, qualified opportunities from events and partnerships, and reliable progress against revenue targets. You must be able to explain what you changed, how it worked and how the team can repeat it.

**Roles & Responsibities**

Sales leadership and account development

1. Own national commercial performance

* Translate national and city revenue targets into channel, territory and account plans.
* Diagnose performance gaps using account potential, referral activity, conversion, capacity and commercial economics.
* Identify the few actions most likely to close those gaps and hold clear owners accountable.
* Maintain a credible forecast and explain variances early.
* Allocate sales effort and approved budgets to opportunities with a clear rationale.
* Work with Finance and the Head of Growth on channel economics, investment decisions and corrective action.

2. Build productive referral relationships

* Segment and prioritise doctors, clinics, hospitals and other relevant partners based on clinical relevance, account potential and relationship stage.
* Understand their unmet needs, referral barriers and current alternatives.
* Develop account plans with a specific proposition, next action, owner and date.
* Activate appropriate new accounts, deepen productive relationships and re-engage lapsed referrers.
* Work with Sukoon clinicians to build professional trust through meaningful conversations and evidence.
* Ensure partners understand referral pathways and receive timely follow-through from the relevant teams.
* Explore partnerships where they support the agreed growth strategy.
* Assess fit, expected demand, delivery requirements, economics and ownership before proposing an investment.
* Referral development remains a core responsibility; expansion into other channels must have a clear business case.

3. Coach in the field

* Spend regular time with city managers and frontline representatives. Observe real meetings, diagnose the skills or account barriers involved and demonstrate effective discovery, value explanation, objection handling and next-step agreement. Give specific feedback and follow up on whether behaviour and results improve.
* Teach managers to coach their teams consistently. Use existing training materials and performance data to identify development needs. Translate training into practice through joint visits, role-play, account reviews and individual development plans. Measure improvements in representative productivity and target attainment.

4. Build a capable sales organisation

* Clarify responsibilities, territory coverage, manager spans and account ownership. Set hiring standards, interview and assess sales talent, improve onboarding and ramp-up, and address persistent underperformance. Make staffing proposals based on workload, geography and account opportunity.
* Create a culture of preparation, honest reporting and reliable follow-through. Recognise results and effective behaviours, and ensure reviews lead to useful decisions. Develop managers who can sustain performance without every issue escalating to the national leader.

Events collateral and commercial execution

1. Create events that develop business

* Design and execute targeted clinician roundtables, facility visits, educational discussions and other relevant engagement formats. Choose the audience and format around a specific account opportunity or referral barrier. Work with clinical colleagues on content and marketing colleagues on invitations and delivery.
* Own the commercial plan for each event: target accounts, proposition, attendee recruitment, approved budget, representative preparation, intended next actions and follow-up. Track full costs and evaluate qualified opportunities, productive accounts and attributable revenue over an agreed period.
* Assign follow-up owners before the event. Ensure opportunities are recorded and progressed in the CRM. Distinguish newly generated business from influence on existing opportunities. Use results to decide which formats to repeat, improve or discontinue.

2. Know what sales collateral to build

* Audit existing materials and identify gaps by audience, sales stage and recurring question or objection. Brief marketing on assets such as referral guides, clinical capability summaries, evidence-based case examples, care-journey explanations, FAQs, presentations and event follow-up material.
* Specify the audience, purpose, message, evidence, format and intended next action for each asset. Work with clinical leaders to validate clinical content and with marketing to maintain brand consistency. Test material in real conversations, teach teams to use it and improve it based on feedback and account progression.

3. Strengthen execution across teams

* Use existing CRM and reporting systems to maintain account plans, activity quality, source attribution, next actions and forecasts. Improve data quality and sales processes where a specific performance gap warrants it. Lead reviews that result in decisions and completed actions.
* Work with admissions and customer care to ensure referral enquiries receive timely attention and a clear handoff. Escalate repeated service or coordination barriers that damage partner trust. Support the clinical team’s patient conversations through relevant information and feedback while respecting assigned ownership.

4. Exercise sound healthcare judgment

* Represent Sukoon accurately and communicate value with evidence. Protect patient confidentiality and ensure patient stories and clinical claims have appropriate approval. Build trust with clinicians, partners and families through clear, respectful communication.
* Clinical decisions remain with clinicians. Commercial targets must support clinically appropriate care and informed patient choice. You are accountable for referral-channel performance and sales execution; clinical recommendations and lengths of stay are not sales decisions.

**How accountability will work**

* Revenue and admission outcomes depend on clinical eligibility, patient choice, facility capacity and patient-facing execution. You will own the sales actions and account relationships within your control, diagnose shared barriers and coordinate resolution. Reviews will distinguish weak sales execution from other causes of performance variance.
* Productive-account and conversion definitions will use consistent windows and denominators. Registered contacts and raw visit counts will not substitute for qualified opportunities or account outcomes. Count unique referrals consistently and avoid duplicate revenue credit across channels and events.
* The scorecard will inform priorities and performance assessment. Incentive terms and weightings will be specified separately in the employment offer.

**What strong performance looks like**

City managers can explain their account priorities and coach their teams effectively. Representatives understand partner needs, communicate Sukoon’s value and secure meaningful next steps. Events create opportunities that are followed through, and collateral solves specific sales problems. Forecasts are reliable and the team can demonstrate progress against targets.

 **Requirements**

**Must Haves**

* Demonstrated commercial experience in healthcare in India, including clinician or referral-partner engagement. A record of leading sales or business-development teams, owning targets and improving results through personal intervention is essential.
* Ability to show field coaching, territory and account development, revenue-generating events and sound sales-collateral judgment. Strong commercial numeracy, CRM discipline and cross-functional execution. Willingness to spend substantial time in the field and travel regularly between markets.
* Typically 12 or more years of relevant commercial experience, with meaningful people-leadership responsibility. We will consider strong regional leaders ready for national responsibility as well as established national leaders. Evidence of performance and capability will carry more weight than title or tenure alone.
* Bachelor’s degree required. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Clear professional communication in English is essential; language capabilities relevant to our markets are valuable.

**Good to have**

* Direct hospital or specialty-healthcare service sales
* Multi-city or multi-facility leadership
* Referral-account development involving complex patient decisions
* Effective work with consultants, marketing and admissions teams.
* Experience in mental healthcare, rehabilitation or addiction services is valuable but not mandatory.

title: Inward and Outward Executive
description:
**Job Overview**

The Inward & Outward Executive is responsible for managing the complete movement of goods into and out of the warehouse. This includes handling **inward GRN**, **outward SRN**, **dispatch**, **e-way bill generation**, **gate pass management**, and maintaining accurate inventory records. The role ensures smooth warehouse operations, proper documentation, and timely coordination with logistics partners, suppliers, and internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities1. Inward Management (GRN)**

* Receive incoming materials and verify them against purchase orders, delivery challans, and invoices.
* Inspect goods for quantity, quality, and damages.
* Prepare and update **GRN (Goods Receipt Note)** accurately in the system.
* Coordinate with the procurement and accounts teams for any discrepancies.
* Ensure proper labeling and storage of all inward materials.

**2. Outward Management (SRN & Dispatch)**

* Process **SRN (Stock Return Note)** for outbound returns or transfers.
* Pick, pack, and dispatch orders as per the requirement.
* Schedule and coordinate dispatch with transporters or internal logistics teams.
* Ensure goods are dispatched on time and in good condition.
* Maintain daily dispatch registers for record-keeping.

**3. E-way Bill & Documentation**

* Generate **e-way bills** for all outward shipments as per statutory requirements.
* Prepare and maintain all necessary documents such as invoices, packing lists, gate passes, and dispatch documents.
* Ensure all documentation is accurate and filed systematically.

**4. Gate Pass Management**

* Issue gate passes for inward and outward material movement (returnable and non-returnable).
* Maintain gate pass logs and ensure proper authorization from relevant departments.
* Coordinate with security personnel for entry/exit of goods.

**5. Inventory Coordination**

* Update inventory records in the system after every inward and outward transaction.
* Monitor stock levels and report shortages/damages immediately.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO or other inventory management practices to ensure optimized stock rotation.
* Assist in monthly/quarterly physical stock verification.

**6. Returns & Reverse Logistics**

* Manage customer returns, vendor returns, and damaged stock returns.
* Inspect returned items and update the system accordingly.
* Coordinate with sales, QC, and accounts teams for return approvals.

**7. Coordination & Communication**

* Work closely with the procurement, logistics, store, and accounts teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Communicate with suppliers, transporters, and warehouse staff for issue resolution.
* Escalate discrepancies, damages, or delivery delays promptly.

**8. Compliance & Quality Control**

* Ensure all operations comply with company policies, safety guidelines, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety within the warehouse area.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in warehouse/logistics operations (inward/outward handling preferred).
* Strong understanding of **GRN, SRN, e-way bills, dispatch, gate pass** and warehouse documentation.
* Knowledge of Tally, ERP systems, or inventory software (preferred).
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with accuracy and attention to detail.

description:

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

**Our Values**

**Customers**

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

**Action**

We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

**Team Spirit**

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

**Innovation**

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

**Excellence**

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

**About the Role:**

The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how

money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.

**What You'll Do:**

**AI Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.

* Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.

* Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

**Product Development & AI Innovation**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.

* Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.

* Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

**Organization Building & Talent**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.

* Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.

* Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

**Market Presence & Commercial Impact**

* Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.

* Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

  
**What You'll Bring:**

**Required Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.

* Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.

* Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.

* Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing applied AI product teams in a fast-moving enterprise SaaS or fintech environment.

* Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.

* Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence across the C-suite, board, customers, partners, and external audiences.

* Strong commercial acumen — able to connect AI product investment directly to revenue growth, retention, and competitive differentiation.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Familiarity with the data structures and integration patterns common in AR automation: ERP connectors, remittance data, invoice line-item detail, payment status feeds, and buyer identity resolution.

* Track record of representing product vision externally — at conferences, in analyst briefings, or in strategic customer advisory settings.

* Experience co-creating AI solutions with enterprise customers and translating those partnerships into roadmap impact and revenue.

title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
company: Dadasaheb Phalke School of Film Studies (DPSFS)
description:
A **Business Development Manager (BDM)** at a filmmaking institute plays a pivotal role in driving revenue, building industry partnerships, expanding student enrollment, and positioning the institute as a premier destination for media education.

Because filmmaking is a deeply portfolio- and industry-driven field, the BDM bridges the gap between **education**, **student recruitment**, and **entertainment industry networks**.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the key roles and responsibilities of a Business Development Manager in a filmmaking institute:

**1. Student Enrollment & Revenue Growth**

* **Lead Generation & Pipeline Management:** Identify, target, and acquire prospective students for various filmmaking courses (Degree programs, Diplomas, Short-term Bootcamps, and Masterclasses).
* **Counseling & Conversion:** Oversee or collaborate with the admissions team to convert leads into enrollments through open days, campus tours, webinar presentations, and 1-on-1 counseling.
* **Corporate & Institutional Tie-ups:** Partner with high schools, colleges, and university arts departments to conduct workshops, talent hunts, and roadshows to build early-funnel awareness.
* **Pricing & Scholarship Strategy:** Analyze market demand to propose competitive pricing models, early-bird offers, or industry-sponsored scholarship programs.

**2. Industry Partnerships & Placements**

* **Production House Tie-Ups:** Build relationships with film production houses, OTT platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hotstar, etc.), ad agencies, and post-production studios to secure internships, apprenticeships, and job placements for students.
* **Guest Lectures & Masterclasses:** Network with established directors, cinematographers, screenwriters, editors, and actors to invite them as guest faculty or masterclass mentors.
* **Equipment & Tech Sponsorships:** Collaborate with camera, lighting, editing, and audio technology brands (e.g., RED, Arri, Blackmagic, Sony, Adobe, DaVinci Resolve) for hardware/software sponsorships, student discounts, and joint workshops.

**3. Brand Outreach, Events & Festivals**

* **Film Festival Collaborations:** Partner with local, national, and international film festivals to showcase student films, host panel discussions, or secure student accreditation/tickets.
* **Campus Events & Open Days:** Plan and execute flagship events such as Annual Student Film Screenings, Film Pitching Competitions, and Industry Mixer Nights.
* **Community Building:** Build relationships with local filmmaking communities, film clubs, and independent creators to keep the institute at the center of the regional film ecosystem.

**4. Product & Course Development Support**

* **Market Research & Trend Analysis:** Keep track of emerging industry trends (e.g., AI in filmmaking, Virtual Production/Unreal Engine, OTT content trends, drone cinematography) and advise the academic head to introduce relevant new courses or workshops.
* **Executive & B2B Training:** Develop corporate training programs, custom workshops for brands, media houses, or content creators seeking upskilling in video production.

**5. Strategic Alliances & Expansion**

* **International Alliances:** Explore student exchange programs, dual-degree pathways, or credit-transfer agreements with foreign film schools and universities.
* **Franchising / Multi-Center Expansion:** If applicable, identify new locations, franchise partners, or online learning platform opportunities to expand the institute’s footprint.

**Summary Matrix of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Focus Area**

**Key Deliverables & Metrics**

**Sales & Revenue**

Student enrollment targets met, total revenue generated across courses.

**Placements**

Number of active production house partnerships, internship/placement rates.

**Industry Relations**

Number of guest masterclasses arranged, brand/tech sponsorships secured.

**Outreach**

School/College workshop counts, film festival tie-ups, lead acquisition rate.

A **Sales Manager for Film Festival Promotion** plays a critical role in driving revenue, sponsorship acquisitions, ticket sales, and strategic commercial partnerships. Unlike traditional sales roles, selling for a film festival requires balancing **B2B sales** (corporate sponsors, brand partners, media outlets) and **B2C sales** (pass holders, delegates, individual moviegoers, film industry professionals).

Here is a comprehensive overview of the key roles and responsibilities for a Sales Manager focused on film festival promotion:

**1. Sponsorship Acquisition & Brand Partnerships (B2B)**

* **Sponsorship Package Development:** Create compelling, tiered sponsorship packages (Headline/Presenting, Category, Associate, Award Category, Hospitality) tailored to prospective brand partners.
* **Pitching & Deal Closing:** Pitch and negotiate with prospective corporate sponsors (e.g., luxury brands, tech companies, media houses, beverage brands, streaming platforms, camera/gear manufacturers).
* **In-Kind & Strategic Partnerships:** Secure non-cash barter/in-kind partnerships for festival logistics, such as travel/airline partners, hotel/hospitality sponsors, food & beverage partners, and media broadcast partners.
* **Brand Activation Planning:** Collaborate with sponsors to design interactive brand activations, lounge experiences, photo booths, and red-carpet branding during the event.

**2. Ticket, Pass & Delegate Sales (B2C & B2B)**

* **Tiered Pass Sales:** Strategy and execution for early-bird, VIP, general admission, industry delegate, and student pass campaigns.
* **Bulk & Institutional Sales:** Sell bulk ticket packages to universities, film schools, drama clubs, corporate groups, and cultural organizations.
* **Box Office Management:** Oversee festival ticketers, online sales channels, and physical box office operations during the festival days.

description:
**Job Description: Strategic Account Manager (SAM) OR Client Partner (EXP: 15+ Years)**

**About Bilvantis:**

Bilvantis is a Data & AI engineering services company with teams in the US, India, the UK and the UAE. We don't work as a vendor. We work as an extension of our clients' own teams. We put our solutions and accelerators into every piece of repeatable work, and we choose to grow deep within a small set of accounts rather than spread thin across many.

**Why this role exists:**

At Bilvantis, growth comes from going deep in each account. The Client Partner owns that. You'll treat your accounts like a business you run: you deepen the relationships we have, open new ones, and keep finding where Bilvantis can create real value for the client. When that works, the account grows.

**What you'll own:**

**Account growth:**

  

* Own the revenue, margin and growth targets for your accounts, and build and run an account plan for each one.
* Find ways to upsell and cross-sell, from new projects and expanded scope to new service lines and our accelerators.
* Co-sell with partners such as Databricks and other technology alliances.
* Keep the pipeline and forecast accurate, and lead proposals from first idea through to signed contract.

**Relationships:**

  

* Build trusted relationships at several levels of the client: executive sponsors, business leaders, technology heads and procurement.
* Move beyond the people we already know and build new relationships across business units and regions.
* Hold the governance cadence: QBRs, steering committees and executive check-ins.

**Mapping client needs to what Bilvantis offers:**

  

* Know the client deeply: their business, priorities, technology landscape, budget cycles, politics and competitors.
* Know Bilvantis just as well: our solutions, accelerators, case studies and people.
* Connect the two by spotting where we can create value before the client asks, and turning that into a clear story they'll fund.

**Working with internal teams:**

  

* Act as the link between the client and the Delivery, Practice, Pre-Sales and Solutions teams.
* Take our existing solutions and people to the client, so they're positioned, staffed and land well.
* Bring client needs and feedback back to the team, and work with them to shape new solutions and offerings.
* Keep a close eye on delivery health and step in early to protect the relationship and our reputation.

**What you bring:**

* **Prior Experience:** 15+ years in IT Services, including 5+ Years in Strategic Account Management (SAM).
* **Stakeholder management:** you're at ease with senior client leaders, and just as good at aligning internal teams without having direct authority over them.
* **Relationship building:** people trust you, inside and outside the company, and you have relationships that have lasted for years to show for it.
* **Business and solution sense:** enough grounding in Data, AI and cloud to talk about value credibly and know when to bring in the experts.
* **Teamwork:** a record of winning together with delivery and pre-sales, not working around them.
* **Communication:** clear and persuasive in writing, in meetings and in front of executives.
* **Commercial skill:** confident with pricing, SOWs, rate negotiations and contract structures.
* **Track record:** you've grown named accounts by 50% or more year on year.

**Nice to have:**

  

* Experience in BFSI or Manufacturing.
* Exposure to the Databricks or hyperscaler partner ecosystems.
* Background at a global systems integrator or a growth-stage services firm.

**How success is measured:**

  

* Year-on-year growth in account revenue and margin.
* New logos or business units opened within existing clients.
* Number of executive relationships, and how many levels of the client they span.
* Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.
* Client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and retention.

**Why join:**

  

* A role that's yours to shape at a company that's growing fast.
* Direct access to leadership, and decisions made quickly.
* Real solutions and accelerators to take to clients, not just people to place.

  18+ years in customer-facing leadership roles, including at least 5 years managing large, geographically dispersed Customer Success or Services teams in enterprise SaaS or cloud technology. You’ve led through change, scaled teams in high-growth environments, and consistently delivered strong business outcomes.
* **Commercial Acumen & Sales Partnership** :
    
  You understand the commercial engine of a SaaS business and bring a business-owner mindset to everything you do. You’re comfortable holding Sales teams accountable for joint outcomes, aligning success strategy to revenue goals, and influencing deal structures and growth plans. You drive cross-functional clarity and make sure the customer’s long-term success is baked into every commercial conversation.

  A track record of driving measurable results against performance targets, including renewals, expansion, adoption, customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), and operational efficiency. You’re skilled at managing budgets, resource allocation, and executive-level reporting.

  Demonstrated success building trusted relationships with senior business and technology executives in large, complex organizations. You understand the language of the C-suite and how to align success initiatives to strategic business goals.

  Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce platform, including its capabilities, use cases, and value drivers across Sales, Service, and Industry Clouds.

You’ve built frameworks for success, managed executive stakeholders, and consistently delivered outcomes that matter to customers’ business goals.

  You’re energized by the opportunity to re-engage a team, establish clarity of mission, and coach individuals to achieve their full potential.
* **Resilience & Agility** :
    
  Calm under pressure, energized by complex challenges, and always thinking two steps ahead. You adapt quickly, move with urgency, and are unafraid to lead through ambiguity.

  

**The Opportunity Ahead:**  
This isn’t just a leadership role—it’s a launchpad.You’ll shape the future of Customer Success —and help our customers accelerate their transformation journeys with confidence.
  
  
If you’re ready to lead boldly, build something great, and drive real outcomes— **we’d love to hear from you.**Apply today and be part of Salesforce, a company where **trust, innovation, and customer success**define everything we do.

Unleash Your Potential

title: Mars Transfer Pricing Transformation Manager
description:
**Job Description:**  
TheMars Transfer Pricing Transformation Manager is responsible for leading transfer pricing requirements, operating model design, process transformation, and SAP S/4HANA solution deployment activities within a global ERP transformation program. The role serves as the primary Tax SME for transfer pricing policies, intercompany transactions, profit allocation methodologies, legal entity reporting requirements, and operational transfer pricing processes. The individual partners with Tax, Finance, Controllership, Supply Chain, Business Units, Shared Services, and IT teams to ensure transfer pricing requirements are embedded within SAP S/4HANA design, supporting compliance, operational efficiency, financial transparency, and audit readiness.
  
  
What are we Looking For?
  
  

* 5-8 years of transfer pricing, tax transformation, or international tax experience.
* Experience working in multinational organizations, consulting firms, or Big Four environments.
* Strong understanding of OECD transfer pricing principles and operational transfer pricing processes.
* Experience with intercompany transactions including product flows, services, royalties, and cost allocations.
* Experience supporting ERP transformations, preferably SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA programs.
* Knowledge of Intercompany, Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Supply Chain processes.
* Experience translating tax policies into process and system requirements.
* Experience supporting business process design workshops, testing, and deployment activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across Tax, Finance, Operations, and IT organizations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Tax, or related field.
* Preferred SAP S/4HANA Transformation Experience:
* Supported transfer pricing workstreams during SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Experience with intercompany process design and Advanced Intercompany functionality.
* Familiarity with Universal Journal, Group Reporting, and management reporting structures.
* Experience supporting transfer pricing true-up and profitability reporting processes.
* Led or coordinated UAT, cutover, deployment readiness, and hypercare activities.
* Worked closely with Global Tax, Finance GPOs, Controllership, Supply Chain, and System Integrator teams.

What are the Key Responsibilities?
  
  

* Support the Global Transfer Pricing Transformation Lead in executing the transfer pricing workstream strategy and roadmap.
* Coordinate transfer pricing requirements gathering across regions, business units, and functional teams.
* Analyze transfer pricing policies and document SAP S/4HANA business and process requirements.
* Support design reviews for intercompany sales, services, royalties, cost allocations, and management fee processes.
* Partner with Finance, Intercompany, Supply Chain, and IT teams to ensure transfer pricing requirements are incorporated into the solution design.
* Assist in defining requirements for transfer pricing calculations, allocations, markups, and true-up processes.
* Review impacts of legal entity structures, plants abroad, principal models, and supply chain operating models on SAP design.
* Support development and execution of transfer pricing testing strategies, test scripts, and defect management processes.
* Track risks, issues, decisions, and action items related to transfer pricing deployment activities.
* Facilitate alignment between global template standards and local business requirements.
* Support change management, training, and deployment readiness activities.
* Assist with audit readiness and documentation supporting transfer pricing compliance objectives.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Transfer pricing business requirements documentation.
* Functional requirements and process design recommendations.
* Intercompany and transfer pricing process flows.
* Transfer pricing calculation and allocation requirements.
* Test scenarios, test scripts, and UAT execution results.
* Defect logs, resolution tracking, and business sign-offs.
* Risks, issues, assumptions, and dependency tracking.
* Transfer pricing controls and governance documentation.
* Training materials and end-user guidance.
* Deployment readiness assessments and cutover support plans.
* Executive status updates and workstream reporting.
* Post-go-live support documentation and stabilization plans.

What can you expect from Mars?
  
  
Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.
* Scales execution capabilities to support platform growth, modernization, and increased customer demand.
* Ensures platform capabilities are fully **productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable**.
* Builds a strong TPM and GPM organization trusted across Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Directly supports Teradata’s **growth and retention goals** by strengthening the foundation of its data platform.

We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Director - Inside Sales & Business Development
description:
ProArch is seeking an experienced, revenue-driven Inside Sales & Business Development leader to drive global pipeline generation, enterprise prospecting, GTM execution, and business growth across North America markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic sales planning with hands-on execution, leading inside sales resources, developing targeted go-to-market programs, engaging enterprise stakeholders, and supporting opportunities through qualification, solution positioning, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.

**The role will work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery teams, and technology partners such as Microsoft to accelerate pipeline growth and improve sales conversion across ProArch's Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation offerings.**

 **Requirements**

**1. Global Inside Sales & Business Development**

* Drive inside sales and business development initiatives across North America, markets.
* Develop territory plans, account penetration strategies, target account lists, and enterprise prospecting programs.
* Identify new business opportunities across Microsoft Cloud, Azure, Fabric , Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation services.
* Build relationships with business leaders, technology executives, and C-level stakeholders to identify business challenges and transformation opportunities.
* Drive qualified pipeline creation, opportunity progression, account acquisition, and revenue contribution.

**2. Go-to-Market Strategy & Demand Generation**

* Develop and execute quarterly GTM strategies aligned with company offerings, revenue objectives, industry verticals, and market opportunities.
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute outbound campaigns, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), Contact-Based Marketing (CBM), and targeted demand-generation initiatives.
* Develop compelling value propositions, industry-specific messaging, email sequences, call scripts, and multichannel prospecting plays.
* Translate ProArch's technical capabilities into business-focused messaging that resonates with enterprise buyers.
* Identify new market segments, buying triggers, technology trends, and cross-selling opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness.

**3. SDR Leadership & Sales Enablement**

* Lead, mentor, and coach SDRs, BDMs, and inside sales professionals to achieve pipeline and business development targets.
* Establish sales development processes, operating cadences, productivity benchmarks, and performance management frameworks.
* Build repeatable prospecting methodologies, qualification frameworks, objection-handling guides, and sales playbooks.
* Train teams to engage enterprise buyers and position complex technology services through consultative selling.
* Monitor individual and team performance, identify execution gaps, and implement corrective action plans to improve productivity and conversion.

**4. Microsoft Ecosystem & Partner-Led GTM**

* Develop co-sell strategies and campaigns around Azure, Microsoft 365, Data & AI, Security, and other relevant Microsoft technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage partner relationships, customer transformation initiatives, and eligible funding programs to accelerate sales conversations.
* Align outbound campaigns with Microsoft priorities, customer needs, and ProArch's service capabilities.

**5. Pipeline Governance, Forecasting & Performance Management**

* Own pipeline reviews, opportunity inspections, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and sales performance reporting.
* Establish KPIs for prospecting activity, qualified opportunities, pipeline value, stage progression, conversion rates, and revenue contribution.
* Review campaign performance and lead-to-opportunity conversion to improve targeting and sales effectiveness.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, deal risks, and growth opportunities.
* Drive accountability through structured weekly reviews, monthly performance assessments, and quarterly business reviews.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to ensure alignment across the sales lifecycle.
* Provide market feedback, buyer insights, competitive intelligence, and campaign performance inputs to refine GTM strategies.
* Ensure effective handoffs between demand generation, sales qualification, opportunity management, and account teams.
* Contribute to the development of scalable sales processes, enablement assets, and technology-driven sales operations.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 12–18 years of experience in inside sales, business development, demand generation, enterprise sales, or technology services sales.
* Proven experience leading inside sales or business development teams serving international markets, preferably North America.
* Strong understanding of IT services and enterprise technology solutions, particularly Cloud, Azure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, or Digital Transformation.
* Demonstrated success in building qualified sales pipelines, developing GTM strategies, and improving opportunity conversion.
* Experience in ABM, outbound prospecting, enterprise account targeting, and consultative selling.
* Experience working with CRM platforms and sales engagement tools, with strong forecasting and pipeline management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, executive engagement, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
* Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to AI-led sales enablement, sales automation, and data-driven demand generation.
* Experience working with Microsoft or other major technology partner ecosystems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against agreed business objectives, including:

* Qualified pipeline generated and pipeline coverage against targets.
* Number and value of sales-qualified opportunities created.
* Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-win conversion rates.
* Pipeline progression, sales cycle effectiveness, and forecast accuracy.
* New logo acquisition and strategic account penetration.
* Revenue contribution and closed-won business, where applicable.
* SDR/BDM productivity, target attainment, and team performance.
* GTM campaign effectiveness and enterprise stakeholder engagement.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker and hands-on sales leader who can translate business growth objectives into actionable GTM plans, build high-performing sales teams, engage enterprise decision-makers, and consistently generate measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.

The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast-paced IT services environment, balancing team leadership with direct involvement in strategic opportunities and commercial sales execution.

title: Incorta Architect
description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced Incorta Developer with 6–10 years of experience in enterprise reporting, analytics, and data modeling. The role will design scalable Incorta data models, develop complex dashboards and reports, integrate multiple source systems, and optimize analytical performance while partnering with business and data engineering teams.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incorta Development and Data Modeling**

* Design and maintain Incorta physical schemas, business schemas, joins, materialized views, formula columns, measures, dimensions, and derived attributes.
* Configure ingestion jobs, data sources, pipelines, load plans, incremental refreshes, and data validation controls.
* Develop reusable semantic and dimensional models that support governed self\-service analytics.
* Translate complex business and reporting requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

**Reporting, Analytics, and Performance**

* Build complex operational, management, and executive dashboards and reports across multiple subject areas.
* Implement calculations, aggregations, filters, drilldowns, KPIs, exception reporting, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot and optimize queries, joins, formulas, schemas, ingestion patterns, and dashboard performance.
* Reconcile report outputs to source systems and resolve data quality or reporting discrepancies.

**Integration and Delivery**

* Integrate Incorta with ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS, finance, HR, and other enterprise source systems using database, API, file, or cloud\-based patterns.
* Work with data engineers on source mappings, transformations, data quality, refresh schedules, and lineage.
* Support design reviews, testing, UAT, defect resolution, releases, production support, and technical documentation.
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior developers and report developers.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* 6–10 years in business intelligence, enterprise reporting, data analytics, or data warehousing, including substantial Incorta development experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Incorta schemas, ingestion, Analyzer, dashboards, security, materialized views, and performance tuning.
* Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, incremental loads, data profiling, and data governance.
* Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar databases; familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder\-management, and documentation skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Incorta certification or formal training; experience with Incorta Cloud.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cognos, or comparable BI tools.
* Experience delivering analytics for supply chain, finance, procurement, sales, operations, or HR.
* Experience with end\-to\-end reporting\-platform implementation, migration, or modernization.

**EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage. The successful candidate demonstrates ownership, attention to data accuracy, structured problem solving, collaboration, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Store Manager
description:
**Job description:**

Job Description – Store Manager

**Salary**

**₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month**

**About Us**

**SuperTeacher Edureforms Pvt. Ltd.** is a fast\-growing EdTech company focused on delivering innovative educational solutions and hands\-on learning experiences. Our **STEM Education Products** are designed to help students develop practical skills in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, creativity, innovation, and problem\-solving.

Position

**Store Manager – STEM Education Products**

**Location:** Nagaram, ECIL  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Department:** Stores / Inventory / Operations

Role Overview

We are looking for an organized and responsible **Store Manager** to manage the complete store and inventory operations for our **STEM Education Products and other educational products**.

The Store Manager will be responsible for managing the movement and availability of **raw materials, components, STEM kits, educational models, finished products, packing materials, tools, consumables, and other inventory** from receipt to final dispatch.

The role requires strong inventory control, documentation, coordination with production and other departments, and effective management of store staff.

Key ResponsibilitiesStore \& Inventory Management

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the store/warehouse.
* Receive and verify all incoming materials and educational products.
* Check quantities, product specifications, and condition of materials received.
* Properly label, categorize, and store all inventory.
* Maintain systematic product\-wise and item\-wise storage.
* Ensure easy identification and retrieval of products and materials.
* Maintain accurate physical and system\-based inventory records.
* Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels.
* Identify stock shortages and inform the concerned team in advance.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconciliation.

STEM \& Educational Product Management

* Maintain inventory of all **STEM Education Products and educational learning products**.
* Manage stock of STEM kits, educational models, activity kits, components, tools, accessories, and learning materials.
* Maintain product\-wise and SKU\-wise stock records.
* Ensure complete kits are available before dispatch.
* Check and track individual components required for assembling STEM kits.
* Maintain records of damaged, missing, defective, or incomplete products.
* Coordinate with the Production/Assembly team for completion of kits and products.

Raw Material \& Component Management

* Maintain stock of raw materials and components required for manufacturing STEM products.
* Issue materials to the Production and Assembly teams against approved requirements.
* Maintain records of material issued, consumed, returned, and balance stock.
* Track material consumption and wastage.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of sensitive or fragile components.
* Coordinate with the Purchase team regarding incoming materials and pending requirements.

Finished Goods Management

* Receive finished STEM products from the Production/Assembly team.
* Verify quantity and condition of finished products.
* Maintain finished\-goods inventory product\-wise.
* Ensure products are properly packed, labelled, and stored.
* Coordinate with the Dispatch team for customer/school/order requirements.
* Ensure the correct product, quantity, and accessories are dispatched.
* Maintain dispatch and stock\-out records.

Inventory Control \& Documentation

* Maintain proper **GRN, Material Issue, Material Return, Stock Transfer, and Dispatch records**.
* Update inventory regularly in the company's ERP/Inventory Management System.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports.
* Maintain accurate stock registers and supporting documents.
* Conduct periodic stock audits.
* Investigate and report stock discrepancies.
* Track damaged, rejected, excess, and obsolete inventory.
* Ensure proper FIFO practices wherever applicable.

Packing \& Dispatch Support

* Maintain sufficient stock of boxes, labels, tapes, packing materials, and other consumables.
* Coordinate with the Dispatch team for daily requirements.
* Ensure products are packed safely to avoid damage during transportation.
* Verify products and quantities before dispatch.
* Ensure dispatch documentation is properly maintained.

Team Management

* Supervise Store Executives, Store Assistants, Helpers, and other store staff.
* Allocate daily responsibilities and monitor work progress.
* Ensure discipline and proper work practices within the store.
* Train staff on material handling, stock management, and documentation.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and organization of the store.

Coordination

The Store Manager will coordinate with:

* **Production Team** – raw material and component requirements
* **Assembly Team** – STEM kit and product completion
* **Purchase Team** – incoming materials and stock requirements
* **Quality Team** – defective/rejected products and materials
* **Dispatch Team** – finished products and order requirements
* **Sales Team** – product availability and order fulfilment
* **Management** – inventory status, shortages, excess stock, and discrepancies

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of store and inventory management.
* Experience handling multiple types of products and SKUs.
* Good knowledge of stock receiving, issuing, storage, and dispatch procedures.
* Strong inventory tracking and reconciliation skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel.
* Experience with ERP or inventory management software.
* Good documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage store staff.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Graduate / Diploma in any relevant field.
* ITI/Diploma in Mechanical, Production, or related fields will be an added advantage.
* **3–5 years of experience in Store / Inventory / Warehouse Management**.
* Experience in a manufacturing, educational products, electronics, toys, STEM products, assembly, or similar environment will be an advantage.
* Experience handling both **raw materials and finished products** preferred.
* Candidates with experience managing multiple SKUs and product components will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Inventory accuracy.
* Timely availability of materials and products.
* Reduction in stock discrepancies.
* Proper documentation and system updating.
* Reduction in product/material damage and loss.
* Timely material issue to Production and Assembly.
* Timely fulfilment of Dispatch requirements.
* Proper organization and housekeeping of the store.
* Effective management of store staff.

Benefits

* Competitive Salary: **₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month**
* Performance\-Based Incentives, where applicable
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Training \& Skill Development
* Opportunity to work with innovative **STEM \& Educational Products**
* Supportive work environment

Schedule

* Day Shift
* Full\-time
* Working hours as per company/factory schedule

Supplemental Pay

* Performance Incentives
* Overtime Pay, as applicable
* Performance/Inventory Achievement Rewards

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off

About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

We are looking for an Operations Manager \- Revenue and Solution Engineering to support our global GTM teams by delivering rapid, quality support to the global Solution Engineering, RevOps and Enablement teams. This role reports to the Senior Director of Services, with dotted\-lines to the Demo Engineering, RevOps and Revenue Enablement leaders, based in the US.
Who you are::
* 2\-5\+ years of leading high performing teams, ideally supporting sales functions
* 3\+ years working with SaaS products and technologies
* Demonstrated ability to work cross functionally
* Familiarity with SaaS businesses, metrics, goals, challenges
* Knowledge of technology in the sales tech, CRM or martech space
* Knowledge of how businesses and sales teams operate in our target market
* Proven strong executive leadership and decision making abilities
* Strong communication skills, ability to articulate and sell a vision internally and externally
* Strong execution skills and the ability to drive action and accountability
* Proven track record of hiring, developing and managing world\-class talent
* Experience working with and/or deploying Sales/Marketing/Service technologies.
* Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce.com, Dynamics 365\).
* Entrepreneurial spirit and mindset, a focus on possibilities and not obstacle
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and change
* Proven track record of defining and optimizing processes
* Strong written and spoken English


What you'll be doing::
* Lead and oversee a team of Revenue Enablement, Revenue Operations and Demo Engineering


practitioners for daily local management.* Support the global Solution Engineering teams to deliver and maintain our standard and custom demo capability.
* Work with the global Enablement \& Operations team to establish the strategy, plan, and prioritization for process and tool enablement for internal teams, including both JIT and formal training strategies.
* Lead and oversee a small team of Revenue Operations system administrators supporting Salesforce and the broader GTM technology stack.
* Scale Organizations, Processes and Operations. Work with global leaders to design, refine and innovate the service and processes as our company grows and evolves.
* Report on key metrics to indicate the success of global programmes.
* Develop a High Performing, High Engagement Team and Culture. Coach and develop your direct reports. Demonstrate very high emotional intelligence. Set and uphold the highest performance standards. Help colleagues “enjoy the ride” \- one of our core guiding principles.
* Partner effectively across functions. Act as an ally and partner to colleagues in sister functions \- Product, Account Management, Marketing and others \- making decisions that take broader perspectives into account and providing insight into others’ decisions. Demonstrate a balanced, reasoned approach to conflict or differing priorities.
* Cultivate deep product knowledge. Gain deep knowledge, understanding, and experience with the Highspot platform and the value it provides businesses.

description:

You will work closely with our technical and design teams to understand requirements and shape the right solutions for clients. **What You'll Do*** Research and identify relevant IT project opportunities through outbound prospecting, freelance marketplaces, referrals, LinkedIn, and other lead channels.

* Own the lead lifecycle — from initial engagement and follow\-ups to negotiation and closure.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with international clients.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong understanding of Web Development, App Development, UI/UX, and Digital Marketing/SEO services.
* Excellent client relationship management, negotiation, follow\-up, and closing skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and consistently achieve business targets.

 **Good to Have*** Experience with freelance/bidding platforms such as Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer, or PeoplePerHour.

* Experience managing international clients across different regions.
* Basic understanding of technical scoping, project estimation, and delivery timelines.
* Experience working with SaaS, product development, or technology consulting companies.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, etc.).

 **Why Techdome?*** Own the end\-to\-end business development lifecycle across multiple channels and international markets.
* Work directly with global clients and diverse technology projects.
* Performance\-driven incentives and career growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to grow into Senior Business Development Executive / Business Development Manager roles.
* Collaborative and flexible hybrid work environment.

You'll be successful in this role if you can consistently identify the right opportunities, build meaningful client conversations, win projects, and turn one\-time engagements into long\-term partnerships.
